description: AI-written or installed nuclei templates and the verdicts of the read-only check (cvENGINE validation.readonly_problem, cvengine_scanner.checks.readonly_problem) and of the own-target-and-port rule (checks.scope_problem). Both sides test against this file.

cases.name: plain_get
cases.template:
id: c
info:
  name: c
  severity: info
http:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/x"
    matchers:
      - type: word
        words: ["marker-1.2.3"]

id: c

  name: c
  severity: info
http:

    path: ["{{BaseURL}}"]

    path: ["{{BaseURL}}/a"]
